command: cd libs/<name> && zig build test --summary all
note: The root `zig build test` runs the same 28 binaries and reports the same total, because the root step compiles the `tests/` roots as well as the inline src/ tests. Re-derive with the command above; a test added without moving this file fails `zig build counts-check`. `poly` went 32 -> 34 on 2026-10-09 when `libs/poly/tests/horner_parity.zig` was added: a cross-library test that compares the four Horner implementations in this tree, counted under `poly` because that is the directory the file lives in, which is the same convention `field`'s 89 follows (14 inline + 75 in `tests/`).
